description: 충청남도_재난안전포털 연안항 현황 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청남도. 이를 통해 각 연안항의 지리적 범위와 위치 특성을 정량적으로 파악할 수 있으며, 해양재난 발생 시 어선 대피, 해안 침수 예측, 방파제 및 항만시설 점검 등 대응 업무에 필요한 기초. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
